notes: KTEL buses run from Fira (Oia 20 min, Perissa 30 min, 2 EUR). ATV or scooter 25-40 EUR/day. Taxis are scarce (25-40 EUR). Buses serve the airport and Athinios port.
From November to March most hotels and restaurants are closed and it is 12-16°C; the caldera is empty, melancholy and beautiful. April-May and October are ideal (sea 20-23°C, sunset at 19:00).
Akrotiri 12 EUR, Thera 6, volcano tour 30-50, catamaran 120+, wine tasting 20-30. Caldera restaurants 30-50, Perissa 15-20. For tips, round up the bill.
Fava (yellow split pea purée), tomatokeftedes, chlorotyri cheese, white aubergine, Assyrtiko and Vinsanto. Santorini tomatoes are tiny.
Do the caldera hike at 07:00-08:00 (in summer). Donkey rides are available. Luggage can't be wheeled in Oia (steps), so stay in Fira or Imerovigli.
The hot springs stain swimsuits. Red Beach has a rockfall warning.

stops.name: Fira Caldera Walking Path
stops.tips: Fira's caldera edge: white cubes and blue domes, with the volcano across the water.

stops.name: Museum of Prehistoric Thera
stops.tips: Akrotiri frescoes (the Blue Monkeys). Small but a must.

stops.name: Fira Catholic Cathedral & Streets
stops.tips: White-and-yellow cathedral, Gold Street shops, donkey rides.

stops.name: Argo Restaurant Fira
stops.tips: Caldera views; fish and fava.

stops.name: Fira Cable Car & Old Port at Sunset
stops.tips: Take the cable car (6 EUR) down to the old port for ship lights. Return by cable car or the 588 steps.

backups.name: Lucky's Souvlakis Fira
backups.tips: Cheap gyros, instead of caldera prices.

backups.name: Santozeum / Megaro Gyzi
backups.tips: Photos of the 1956 earthquake in the Gyzi mansion; a museum alternative.

stops.name: Skaros Rock
stops.tips: 1 hour from Fira along the caldera path (set off at 07:00 in summer). A Venetian fortress rock below Imerovigli with the best views, free.

stops.name: Imerovigli–Oia Trail
stops.tips: Profitis Ilias chapel and a ridge of volcanic rock, then the descent into Oia. Carry 1.5 litres of water.

stops.name: Melitini Oia
stops.tips: Meze restaurant in Oia for lunch, with a sea-view terrace.

stops.name: Ammoudi Bay
stops.tips: Winter cove with fish tavernas (some open).

stops.name: Oia Castle
stops.tips: Ruins of the Agios Nikolaos fortress and the world-famous sunset. Grab a spot 1 hour early (or book a restaurant). Expect crowds and a bus back.

backups.name: Sunset Ammoudi Taverna
backups.tips: Grilled octopus by the bay at Ammoudi.

backups.name: Atlantis Books Oia
backups.tips: Cave-like bookshop, instead of the bay.

stops.name: Nea Kameni Volcano Boat
stops.tips: Boat from the old port (tour 30-50 EUR) to the volcanic island.

stops.name: Nea Kameni Crater Walk
stops.tips: Black lava path 130 m up to the crater, with sulphur fumes. Park fee 5 EUR.

stops.name: Palea Kameni Hot Springs
stops.tips: Jump off the boat and swim to muddy 35°C water (wear a dark swimsuit).

stops.name: Thirassia Island Lunch
stops.tips: Quiet island across the caldera. Taverna in Korfos village (if included in your tour), steps up to Manolas.

stops.name: Return to Oia via Ammoudi
stops.tips: The boat returns to Ammoudi or Fira.

backups.name: Catamaran Caldera Cruise
backups.tips: Catamaran trip to Red Beach, White Beach and the hot springs, with food and drinks included. An alternative to the volcano tour (afternoon sunset version).

backups.name: To Psaraki Vlychada
backups.tips: Fish at Vlychada harbour, if you skip the tour.

stops.name: Akrotiri Archaeological Site
stops.tips: The Minoan Pompeii of 1600 BC (three-storey houses under ash). Covered roof, go in the morning.

stops.name: Red Beach
stops.tips: A winter view of the cliffs.

stops.name: Akrotiri Lighthouse
stops.tips: 1892 lighthouse at the island's southwestern tip, with views.

stops.name: The Cave of Nikolas Akrotiri
stops.tips: Beach taverna in Akrotiri: tomatokeftedes (tomato fritters) and fava.

stops.name: Vlychada Beach
stops.tips: In winter: the tomato factory museum and white cliffs.

backups.name: Tomato Industrial Museum Vlychada
backups.tips: 1945 tomato paste factory, telling the story of Santorini's tiny tomatoes.

stops.name: Pyrgos Village & Kastelli
stops.tips: The island's highest village, with a Venetian castle quarter and 360° views. Few tourists.

stops.name: Santo Wines Pyrgos
stops.tips: Cooperative with caldera views. Taste Assyrtiko and Vinsanto (6 wines) with meze.

stops.name: Megalochori
stops.tips: Quiet village with a bell tower, wine cellars and a square.

stops.name: Venetsanos Winery
stops.tips: 1947 winery carved into the cliff. Go early for sunset.

stops.name: Domaine Sigalas Oia
stops.tips: In winter, Sigalas is by appointment only.

backups.name: Art Space Winery Exo Gonia
backups.tips: Art gallery in a cave winery, instead of Venetsanos.

backups.name: Metaxy Mas Exo Gonia
backups.tips: Locals' favourite taverna. Book ahead; an alternative to Santo.

days.theme: East coast beaches: Perissa and Kamari

stops.name: Ancient Thera
stops.tips: Dorian-Roman city on Mesa Vouno mountain. Zigzag road up from Kamari (taxi or scooter), with the agora and sea views.

stops.name: Perissa Black Beach
stops.tips: A winter walk on black sand.

stops.name: Perivolos Tranquilo Beach Bar
stops.tips: Sustainable beach bar serving couscous and burgers.

stops.name: Kamari Beach
stops.tips: Across from Perissa (a mountain separates them). Promenade and black pebbles, plus an open-air cinema (summer).

stops.name: Kamari Open Air Cinema
stops.tips: In winter, an evening stroll along the Kamari promenade.

backups.name: Monastery Kamari
backups.tips: Restaurant in a monastery courtyard in Kamari.

backups.name: Eleftherios Venizelos Museum Kamari
backups.tips: Small museum, a rainy-day alternative to the beach.

stops.name: Mezzo Imerovigli Breakfast
stops.tips: Breakfast with caldera views, quiet in the morning. Greek yoghurt and honey.

stops.name: Anastasi Church Imerovigli
stops.tips: Blue dome and bell. Visit after breakfast.

stops.name: Fira Factory Souvenirs
stops.tips: Vinsanto, capers, fava and volcanic stone souvenirs in Fira.

stops.name: Santorini Airport
stops.tips: From Fira: bus 20 minutes or taxi 25 EUR. Farewell (30 minutes to Athinios port for the ferry).

backups.name: Mama's House Fira Breakfast
backups.tips: Legendary cheap giant breakfast, near Fira bus station.

backups.name: Skaros Morning Walk
backups.tips: Return to the rock, instead of souvenir shopping.
